<p style="font-size:14px; color:#9a9890; line-height:1.5; margin:0 0 6px; padding:0; max-width:480px;">Spatial Computing, Digital Twins, Avatars, Economics and Digital Habitation on the New Frontier</p>

<h2 style="font-family:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif; font-size:26px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.25; margin:0 0 8px; padding:0; color:#e8e6e1;">Digital Cities of Tomorrow</h2>
<p style="font-size:14px; color:#9a9890; line-height:1.7; margin:0; padding:0; max-width:500px;">AI, planning, spatial computing, GeoAI, and the future of the digital city. Draws on the SMART framework (Hudson-Smith, Hügel &amp; Roumpani, 2020) and the Digital Planning Directory to explore how artificial intelligence is reshaping urban systems and the role of the human planner.</p>

<h2 style="font-family:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif; font-size:26px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.25; margin:0 0 8px; padding:0; color:#e8e6e1;">Digital Urban</h2>
<p style="font-size:14px; color:#9a9890; line-height:1.7; margin:0; padding:0; max-width:500px;">Drawing on two decades of research, practice, and making at the intersection of digital technologies and urban environments.
